spec_match.rationale: Each step is the real surface: synchronous createSendGroup on a connecting transport, the group's real getStats promise, and createUnidirectionalStream with throwing-getter-free getters observing exactly which WebTransportSendStreamOptions members (sendGroup, sendOrder, waitUntilAvailable) the build converts at call time.

interactive.rationale: Four sequenced buttons gate on real capability (steps 2–3 disable when createSendGroup is absent), each writing its own result panel from live outcomes, including the timeout-raced promises.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises real group creation, real stats, a real stream attempt, and the conversion observation; the four steps map one-to-one.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers method-absent (steps disabled with the reason), stats pending/resolved/rejected (naming Firefox's NotSupportedError for comparison), and the stream promise's three honest outcomes (resolve/reject/pending) against a dead endpoint.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus, the send-group interface, and createUnidirectionalStream.

conformance.rationale: The suite's createsendgroup-while-connecting and stream-options-converted-at-call-time assertions encode this page's two live checks; 0 pass / 8 fail / 2 blocked honest on Chromium 141.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via the repo CDP harness (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): steps 1 and 4 driven at 1280×900 and 360×740 — transport constructed, createSendGroup correctly reported absent with steps 2–3 disabled, the stream promise rejected NetworkError on connection failure with all three option members honestly reported unconverted; overflowX 0, zero failed requests. Partial: steps 2–3 and the conversion-observed path need a 153+/flagged build.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts each step's outcome with payloads; every promise is caught or timeout-raced so the dead session cannot emit unhandled rejections.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; step cards on bg-stone with paper result boxes; disabled buttons keep the palette at reduced opacity.

accessibility.rationale: Each step's result is its own polite region; buttons are native, sequenced, and disabled with context in the transport panel rather than hidden.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Driven at both classes with 0px horizontal overflow; result boxes wrap monospace text; both screenshots read.

openQuestions.title: Run steps 2–3 on a 153+ build
openQuestions.detail: On Chrome 153+/flagged, createSendGroup() should return a real group while connecting, its getStats() should resolve zeroed counters (or record whatever it really does), and step 4 should report all three option members converted. When an HTTP/3 endpoint exists, the stream attempt should resolve a WebTransportSendStream.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region status readout for async API probe result
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Separate polite regions per result surface; meaningful final text; keep disabled controls discoverable.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Four step panels each carry one aria-live result; disabled steps stay visible with the reason stated in the transport panel; interstitial text is replaced in-region.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive sequenced step cards without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Stacked card sections with wrapping monospace output and wrapping button rows.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Steps stack as bordered cards; the controls row flex-wraps; 0px page overflow at 360px.

summary: Four real calls against a connecting transport: group mint, group stats, stream attempt, and call-time dictionary conversion observation. Verified with the repo headless-Chromium CDP harness (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud environment) on Chromium 141: honest absent/unconverted outcomes with a real NetworkError rejection narrated, clean console/network, 0px overflow both classes.
